Cede Lite is a Java based, web browser client application that was written as a supplement to the ProCede application. It also performs the Facultative Contract processing and sends the premium information to downstream systems.
Cede Lite was designed to perform actions on the ProCede database that the Ceded Reinsurance business area deemed as needed that the ProCede application itself lacked. It was then enhanced to allow Ceded Reinsurance business validate and process the Facultative premiums.
These actions include the creation of bill dates for transactions entered via the posting manager, editing of Contract Codes, validate the Facultative transactions, create billing invoices and statements for the contracts.
